summaries.n-super-intelligence: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence" (Fox News). On 2026-10-04 the official @WhiteHouse account posted an announcement of a "Super Intelligence Force (SIF)", and Watcher.Guru and an @wallstreetbets post reported Elon Musk saying SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI; a 2026-10-15 post reports that the task force is due to hold its first meeting (e1:4). Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term; other coins followed, including another SI on pump.fun, Super Intelligence Force (SIF), Superintelligence Owl, two SpaceXSI coins on StonkFun, SpaceX Inu ($SI on Flap), Act II: The SI Prophecy, and three BNB Chain coins on Flap named TeslaSI ("Tesla Super Intelligence", pool created 2026-10-11; a second whose Chinese metadata says it follows the SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename; and, since 2026-10-20, テスラSI, pool created 2026-10-19 02:34 UTC, whose Japanese metadata says Musk announced SpaceXAI becomes SpaceXSI and describes a 3% trade tax with 30% paid as on-chain dividends to holders). The Tetsuo Super Intelligence coin on pump.fun (TSI, Solana) joined on 2026-10-18 with a pool 4.6 hours old at discovery: traders' posts call TSI "another SI coin" and one says Elon Musk posted about it (e1:1), which is unverified. Its Clanker twin on Robinhood Chain left on 2026-10-20 after 24h pool volume of $277 and then $0. SPACEXSI and Ollie (pump.fun) left on 2026-10-17, and SIGF (pump.fun) and SuperHooks (Pons) on 2026-10-18, after their 24h pool volume stayed under $1,000. None is shown to be affiliated with the announcements. SpaceXSITeslaBoringaLink (SXSITBL, pump.fun) joined on 2026-10-19: its name combines SpaceXSI with Tesla and Boring, its pool was created on 2026-10-19 at 03:47 UTC, and nothing seen ties it to the announcements. Smaller coins named for SpaceXSI or TSI under the $100K market cap bar are not counted. 四 ("four", read as SI) on four.meme left on 2026-10-21 after its 24h pool volume stayed under $1,000. On 2026-10-27 at 16:18 UTC an account that republishes his Truth Social posts quoted President Trump asking when the Wall Street Journal will start calling AI "SI (Super Intelligence)" and saying the term "AI/Artificial Intelligence" will soon be banned in relevant documents (e5:0). Super Iguana (SI, Pump.fun; metadata "Donald Trump Just post about SI on his social") was created at 16:48 UTC the same day and joined on 2026-10-28; its metadata is its own claim and nothing ties it to the administration. Measured: twelve coins across all their pools.
